race.comment: THE CELLIST (11) ran a good race first up at Wangaratta, beaten under a length in a bunched finish. Fitter now and Ben Allen on is a positive. This looks a fairly winnable race second up and he should go close from the good draw. DARING PRINCE (10) ran a sound race on debut at Geelong, sent out as a 20/1 chance but running on well into fourth. Can improve and takes holding out with natural improvement up to a suitable trip. FIERCE RUBY (6) made sharp improvement last start to grab second at Wangaratta, her first run on turf. Warrants respect now.  SHEZA RAVEELA (8) is going okay and has each way claims.
